title: Her age, schooling and colleges
summary: Austin gives her age as 82, birthplace Chattanooga, and her schooling at high school and two colleges.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Do you mind telling how old you are now unless some people don't want to tell me? I'm 83. 83. What was your birth date when you...
19th of September. 19th? 19th of September I will be 83. I'm 82 now.
And the 19th of September I'll be 83. You look wonderful for that age.
And I graduated from high school then,
and I went to Roddy Williams University.
And when Roddy was at Nashville, Tennessee, and when the school was born, then I went from Roddy Williams to Nashville, Tennessee, to Nashville College.
What's the big college that's theirs at Tuskegee, at Nashville?
That's in Alabama. What's the... PISC. PISC, sure. That's in Nashville. PISC is the one at Nashville.
But you see, my people were Baptists, so we went to Roddy Williams. So you went to... And PISC was kind of a congregation of them.
Yes, I didn't know what the denomination.
But then I went to Nashville College. Yeah.
